description: Exploratory paired 2x2 signal-window ablation. Holds the S=.75/U=.50, D16, half-RB threshold, K10 mechanism fixed while comparing standard W20 versus current-production capacity weighting and urgent W5 versus the current-production reservation signal. Five paired seeds across the five headline loads are intended as a directional 5-10 minute smoke test, not confirmatory evidence.
